title: IntegrationSignal
description: The governance integration signal written to .harness/config.json by /council-kickoff. Models the 'governance' key that informs trine-eval of council presence. Includes taxonomy_version '2.0' per §11.10.

governance.description: Governance configuration block written to .harness/config.json at kickoff.

enabled.description: Whether the henka-council governance layer is active.

council_state_path.description: Path to the council state directory (always .council/).

taxonomy_version.description: Version of the 4M henkaten taxonomy in use.
